title: The Drowned Street
journal: Nesh-Deeka sent me with the keystone to the Chime-Keepers of Toklea, who keep what is left of Kothringi lore. I'm to show it to their elder in the Kothringi Greathouse.
objectives: Show the keystone to the elder of the Chime-Keepers in Toklea. (marker: Hums-the-Long-Note)

plan.going: The keystone from the wreck is Kothringi; the Chime-Keepers' elder may know what it opens.
plan.next: Take boats to Lujei Ferry, cross to Toklea and show the keystone to the elder in the Kothringi Greathouse.

answers: I work for Nesh-Deeka of the Toh-Reel-Ka in Helstrom. I took a Kothringi Keystone from the Pale Harvest wreck. The Collector (Ennodius Vanin) and the Unbound are hunting the Eye, so the keystone seems to matter.
Go into the Kothringi Greathouse in Toklea and show the keystone to the elder, Hums-the-Long-Note (the quest marker).
I can talk to the elder calmly and show the keystone and ask about it. I could also ask other Chime-Keepers. I see no other choice yet.
I do not know what the Eye is, what the keystone does, or who the Unbound really are. I hope the elder can tell me.

title: The Drowned Street
journal: Hums-the-Long-Note knows the keystone, and named her price: her family's carved grave-stake lies in a chest in the drowned street of Zul-Etha, and she wants it raised. Crocodiles lie on the roof peaks above it. I may kill them from a roof or from range, calm them with Illusion, or swim under them unseen to the chest.
objectives: Raise the grave-stake from the chest in Zul-Etha's drowned street. (marker: Drowned Chest)

plan.going: The elder will say what the keystone opens if I raise her family's grave-stake.
plan.next: Go to Zul-Etha and take the grave-stake from the chest under the water.
plan.ways: Kill the crocodiles (from a roof or from range), calm them with Illusion, or swim under them unseen.
terms: Zul-Etha: Hums-the-Long-Note: a carting village the washes drowned, south-east of Mir-Xal

answers: Hums-the-Long-Note recognises the keystone but wants payment first: her family grave-stake, in a chest in drowned Zul-Etha.
Go to Zul-Etha (from Mir-Xal quay, south-east) and raise the stake from the Drowned Chest, then return to her.
Crocodiles and an old bull lie on three roof peaks: kill them from a roof or with arrows, calm them with Illusion (the calm way suits me), or swim under unseen.
I do not know where Mir-Xal quay is exactly or how to get there; the map or travel command should show it. I still do not know what the keystone is.

title: The Drowned Street
journal: I raised the grave-stake from the drowned street. I'm to bring it to Hums-the-Long-Note in the Kothringi Greathouse in Toklea.
objectives: Bring the grave-stake to Hums-the-Long-Note in Toklea. (marker: Hums-the-Long-Note)

plan.going: I have the stake; the elder owes me the keystone's story.

answers: I raised the Carved Grave-Stake from the drowned chest without the crocodiles bothering me. It is the price Hums-the-Long-Note asked for the keystone lore.
Take it back to Hums-the-Long-Note in the Kothringi Greathouse, Toklea.
Just return and give it to her, then ask about the keystone. No other choice visible.
I still do not know what the keystone is or what the Eye is; I hope she tells me.

title: The Drowned Street
journal: Hums-the-Long-Note took her family's stake and kept her word: the keystone opens the tomb of the knight-captain at Eurydike, a ruin near Gideon. The Kothringi knights of Gideon were the last to guard the kings' road to the Root. I'm to tell Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom.
objectives: Tell Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom what the keystone opens. (marker: Nesh-Deeka)

plan.going: The keystone opens the knight-captain's tomb at Eurydike, on the old road to the Root.
terms: Eurydike and the knights of Gideon: Hums-the-Long-Note: the hall of Kothringi knights who served in Gideon's garrison and guarded the kings' road to the Root

answers: Hums-the-Long-Note took the stake and told me the keystone opens the tomb of the Kothringi knight-captain at Eurydike, a roofless hall north of Gideon. The knights guarded the old kings road to the Root, and the captain was buried with what marked the way.
Go to Helstrom and tell Nesh-Deeka.
Report to Nesh-Deeka; I could also go to Eurydike myself, but the journal says tell her first.
I do not know what the Root is, or where Gideon and Eurydike are. Nesh-Deeka may know.

title: The Drowned Street
journal: Nesh-Deeka heard me out. She already knew that the Unbound have been asking Gideon's diggers about Eurydike. When I asked how, she said "we listen" and told me to hurry. She paid me 100 gold.

plan.going: The Unbound are close behind on the same trail; Nesh-Deeka knows it and will not say how.
plan.next: MN09 starts; its first entry marks Eurydike.

answers: The quest is done. Hums-the-Long-Note, for the grave-stake, told me the keystone opens the knight-captain tomb at Eurydike near Gideon, a step towards the Eye of Argonia at the Root. Nesh-Deeka paid me 100 gold and says hurry because the Unbound are asking Gideon diggers about Eurydike. She will not say how she knows ("we listen").
Nothing is assigned now; the likely next step is Eurydike near Gideon, but I have no marker.
Go to Eurydike with the keystone, or ask Nesh-Deeka more first.
